name: popsicle
headline: Social Stream: Content Curation & Scheduling
short_description: Social Stream is a tool for social media managers and marketers that simplifies the content creation process. It allows users to set up customized feeds based on relevant sources, curate AI-generated descriptions and schedule posts for social media platforms. This ensures users have fresh content and consistent posting.
author: prajwalrajup

sections.overview:
Social Stream streamlines content creation for social media managers and marketers by aggregating relevant information from industry sources, news websites, and blogs. The tool enables users to set up customized feeds aligned with their brand or industry, then pulls in content to curate with descriptions and schedule posts across Instagram, LinkedIn, and other platforms. Features include post scheduling with cron-based timing for consistent engagement, basic image editing and resizing, and social listening to monitor brand mentions and industry trends. This automation saves time for businesses looking to maintain an active social media presence without manual content sourcing.
Schedule Instagram and LinkedIn posts from curated industry news feeds
Monitor brand mentions and engage with audiences through social listening
Resize and edit social media images before posting
Maintain consistent posting schedule across multiple platforms

```
Act as a social media manager for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business. Create a 7-day social media content plan using [DATA] from industry blogs, competitor pages, and trending topics. Generate engaging captions and hashtags for each post, and suggest optimal posting times for [PLATFORM].
```
